title: Religion Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for religion blueprints.

entries.title: Who speaks?
entries.description: Identify the speaker before judging the line.

entries.title: What is the target?
entries.description: Identify the person, symbol, or institution being addressed.

entries.title: What is the intent?
entries.description: Determine whether the line educates, condemns, attacks, or remains neutral.

entries.title: What is the context?
entries.description: Check for documentary, educational, court, or fictional framing.

entries.title: What is the evidence?
entries.description: Locate the literal phrase that supports the reading.

entries.title: What relationships matter?
entries.description: See how concepts reinforce or contradict each other.
